description:
FILED s520 (Fable, 2026-10-18 10:2x) from the attribution of s519b's harness-exception companion run (comp.log 09:17: op/stash.t 27 NEW ROW + LOST 28 passing rows, uni/stash.t 25 NEW + LOST 26).  A REGRESSION ON MAIN since s518e's merge (MAIN-READY-28, 2026-10-18 01:1x; code fca3593b, #3281 the core B shim) -- confirmed by one-file companion runs (review/stash-main29.log on main 02a35add; review/stash-base.log on fca3593b): BOTH read op/stash.t 20/7 and uni/stash.t 17/6 against the snapshot's 48/7 and 43/6, serial re-run agrees (REAL MOVE), identical row lists -- so the mover is main's, not s519b's.

CAUSE: `aborted-forms:1: B::CV::CvFLAGS is not supported by PCL (a sub carries no CV flags; see docs/not-supported.md)`.  op/stash.t:66 `eval { require B; 1 } or skip "no B", 29;` -- before the shim, `require B` FAILED and the whole 29-row block was SKIPPED (rows produced as skips); with the shim `require B` succeeds, the block runs, and at :79 `is( b($sub)->CvFLAGS & $CVf_ANON, $CVf_ANON, "...and CVf_ANON set")` the shim's designed die aborts the FILE -- 28 rows (26 in uni/stash.t) are never produced, including the GV / STASH / CvSTASH rows further down that the shim could answer.  The rows the file reaches before :79 pass.

WHY IT SAT ON MAIN: s518e's bounded companion leg named op/method universal ref caller symbolcache + mro/overload_c3 (its runtime areas), not op/stash.t; under the ROUND-LEVEL CADENCE (DECIDED ## s519) the round-1 companion half was deferred until s519a + s519b merged, so the loss was found by s519b's harness-exception companion 8 hours after the merge -- #3361 DATA POINT 3 (the first regression that sat on main for a round; attribution cost Fable two one-file runs, 4 minutes).

FIX SHAPE (lib/B.pm, a SHIM -- rule 9a; emission-neutral): `B::CV::CvFLAGS` answers the bits PCL KNOWS -- CVf_ANON (128) when the sub's recorded name is `__ANON__` (`builtin::sub_name`, #3281's primitive), CVf_ISXSUB 0, CVf_CONST when the sub is a constant sub if the runtime records it, CVf_LVALUE / CVf_METHOD from the attributes if recorded -- and reports the OTHER bits as 0.  That last part is a rule-12 question: a bit read as 0 is a claim.  RULING WANTED (one line): (a) answer the known bits, document in docs/not-supported.md's B section that the unknown CV flag bits read 0 (an ANNOUNCE-class limitation: the value is consumed, but the alternative is losing the 54 rows the die aborts, and perl's own test masks with CVf_ANON only), or (b) keep the die and register the two stash files' rows as the shim's cost.  Fable's recommendation: (a) -- the test's own mask is the measured use; a perl probe of `CvFLAGS` on a named sub, an anon sub, a constant sub and a lexical sub (`my sub`) gives the oracle bits to compare.  BAR: op/stash.t and uni/stash.t back to their snapshot rows (48/7, 43/6) or better in `tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 op/stash.t uni/stash.t`; their rows in baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv / perl-suite-run.tsv edited ROW BY ROW; a guard row in Pl/t/b-shim-01.t (CvFLAGS & CVf_ANON on an anon sub = 128, on a named sub = 0, perl oracle); the sweep (a lib/ change).

Until fixed: s519b splices the snapshot rows citing THIS task (never re-bless); the round-1 companion on the merged main will show the same two files.
subject: B::CV::CvFLAGS dies by design and ABORTS op/stash.t + uni/stash.t (28 + 26 rows never produced) -- a regression on main since s518e's B shim (#3281) that sat one round; fix = the shim answers the CV flag bits PCL knows (ruling: unknown bits read 0, or keep dying)
